why: This service has no `init: true`: the app is PID 1 with no signal forwarding or zombie reaping, so docker stop waits 10 s then SIGKILLs it mid-request. Every service gets init: true.
bad:
services:
  mongo:
    image: mongo:8.2.3
    init: true
  api:
    image: registry/api:1.2.3
    ports: ['3000']
good:
services:
  mongo:
    image: mongo:8.2.3
    init: true
  api:
    image: registry/api:1.2.3
    init: true
    stop_grace_period: 15s
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "true"]
